title: Interactions between extracellular polymeric substances and engineered nanoparticles in aquatic systems and their environmental effects: a comprehensive review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2177-2192
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00073D, Critical Review
Xuan Gao, Haozhe Zhang, Xiaonan Zhang, Chaozhi Zhang, Chenxi Mao, Shengdao Shan, Fang Wei, Monika Mortimer, Jing Fang
The key roles of EPS in influencing the environmental processes and toxicity of NPs in aquatic systems are discussed and presented.
